name: Window Decor with Hanging Piece
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    This window decor is available in a variety of unique materials, allowing customers to choose the perfect finish to match their style:
    - Aluminum – 1mm thick: Sleek and modern with a lightweight yet durable feel, ideal for a minimalist look.
    - Wood – 3mm thick: Natural, warm, and rustic, perfect for cozy or classroom-themed environments.
    - Transparent Acrylic –  3mm thick: Crystal-clear and elegant, gives a light, floating effect when hung near a window.
    - Starburst Acrylic –  3mm thick: Features a radiant, shimmering pattern that catches and reflects light beautifully.
    - Broken Glass Acrylic –  3mm thick: Eye-catching and textured, mimics a cracked glass look for an artistic, edgy appearance.
    Each material type enhances the decor’s charm in a different way, making it a customizable gift or personal accessory suitable for any décor style.
  • Included Accessories:
    - Metal chains and jump rings to connect all parts.
    - Lobster clasp hook for easy hanging on windows, hooks, or rearview mirrors.
    - Pre-attached charm (e.g., an apple) and custom nameplate (e.g., “Mrs. Smith”), both of which dangle freely for added charm and movement.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:
    Main Piece Size: Available in 5 size options to suit any display area:
    - 10x10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - 8x8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - 6x6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    - 4x4 inches ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
  • Hanging Piece Size: Choose from a variety of sizes to match different display needs.
    - 4x4 inches with a 2x2 inches acrylic hanging piece
    - 6x6 inches with a 3x3 inches acrylic hanging piece
    - 8x8 inches with a 4x4 inches acrylic hanging piece
    - 10x10 inches with a 4x4 inches acrylic hanging piece

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and fade-resistant images. The product is printed on both sides, ensuring visibility and color consistency from any angle.

 

  • Functionality Use:
    Perfect for decorating classroom windows, home study spaces, office areas, or car mirrors. Comes with a metal chain for easy hanging. The dangling elements (such as apple charm and nameplate) add a fun, eye-catching motion effect.

 

  • Perfect Gift For All Occasions:
    A thoughtful and personalized gift for teachers, students, friends, or coworkers on any special occasion – including Teacher Appreciation Week, back-to-school season, holidays, or birthdays. A delightful touch to brighten any space!

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1xWindow Decor with Hanging Piece

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
